Northrop Grumman Defense Systems is seeking a Project Change Engineer. This position is located in Roy, Utah and supports the Sentinel program. 

What You’ll Get To Do:

Oversee the development, request, and implementation of changes to the Program and technical baseline with a focus on ensuring changes are well understood, documented, and executed through the Program approved Change Boards. The Project Change Engineers bring a “cradle to grave” solution for Program changes.

Specific duties to include, but are not limited to the following: 

  • Develop change request packages and represent the package through the change board process

  • Ensure change request package meets quality standards and is board ready

  • Coordinate comment follow-up, resolution, and approvals

  • Coordinate and provide input into impact assessments

  • Coordinate resolution and closeout of board action items

  • Interface with Configuration Management when submitting change requests and finalize change requests after board approval

  • Ensure approved change requests are implemented prior to change request closure

  • Follow through to ensure change requests are closed timely

Basic Qualifications:   

  • Must be a US Citizen with an active U.S. Government Secret Clearance, at time of application, current and within scope, with an investigation date within the last 6 years

  • Must be able to be successfully screened for Enhanced Security Clearances, within a reasonable amount of time as determined by the company to meet its business needs

  • Bachelor of Science degree in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) discipline and 2 years of experience; 0 years with Master’s

  • 2 yrs of experience with MS Office Suite

  • 2 yrs Presentation experience with the ability to present to project and program management, other technical managers, and customers

  • 2 yrs Technical writing experience in school or work

Preferred Qualifications: 

  • Current DoD Top Secret clearance

  • Understanding of systems engineering principles and processes

  • Direct experience using the DOORS Requirements Management Database

  • Familiarity with Model Based Systems Engineering concepts and
    Subcontractor technical oversight experience

  • 1 year of project management experience
